newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply one trln won to banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply one trln won to banks.

text.p: The Bank of Korea plans to supply one trillion won to the banking system on Wednesday through overnight repurchase agreements, an official at the bank said.
"The bank decided to supply the money to banks after taking into account that banks were short of required reserves," the Bank of Korea official said.
On Tuesday concerns about the reserve shortages depressed trading sentiment on the bond market, sending benchmark bond yields to higher closes.
Yields on three-year corporate bonds closed 15 basis points higher at 11.65 percent on Tuesday.
